How the finish works

The scene is real 3D. Pixel art uses a small render target, outlines depth changes, adds optional ordered dithering, and chooses from 90 colours in OKLab colour space. Raw 3D shows the same geometry without those effects. The orthographic camera is aligned to the pixel grid in pixel mode.

This is an original rendering study based on the described Hollybrook Open techniques, using Tiny Castle colours and Crown & Dust models. It is a browser prototype; VR and AR hardware have not been tested.
